facts.fact: By 2026 the General Tax Directorate (DGI) had deployed AI for fraud detection and modules to identify taxpayers not registered for the housing tax and municipal services tax; for 2027 it plans an audit-assistant agent and dynamic taxpayer risk rating.
Moroccan customs relies on predictive analytics to combat fraud, per the article.
AI is in use in two sectors' public systems, tax (DGI fraud detection) and customs (predictive analytics for fraud).
facts.system: DGI AI fraud detection; customs predictive analytics
